name: Family Residence Card (Dependents of a CIE Holder)

requirements.blocker_text: Spouses and children of a foreign resident holding a Carte d'Identité d'Étranger (CIE) may apply for their own residence card as dependents, following a broadly similar registration process at the Division de la Police des Étrangers (DPETV) -- proof of the family relationship, the sponsor's valid CIE or receipt, and (per general CIE practice) a medical exam and repatriation deposit.
requirements.fix_path: Apply at DPETV with proof of the family relationship and the sponsor's valid residence documentation.

evidence_required.document: Marriage certificate or child's birth certificate
Sponsor's valid CIE or residence receipt

outcome.duration_length: tied to the sponsor's CIE validity

sources.title: OpenShores (private relocation/immigration guide) -- general description of bringing family to Senegal alongside a foreign resident, referencing the same CIE-based residence framework used for work permits
